announcements.title: Kite Flying Competition - April 17
announcements.body: Join us for our Annual Kite Flying Competition on April 17 at 4:00 PM on the A.R.M.S. grounds. All kites must be handcrafted by the participant. Budget: $10,000 - $15,000. Every kite must successfully fly to qualify for judging. NO PRE-MADE KITES!

announcements.title: Arrival Day Celebration
announcements.body: Anna Regina Multilateral School will be celebrating Indian Arrival Day with a special programme highlighting the cultural heritage and contributions of Indo-Guyanese people. All students are encouraged to participate in cultural attire.

announcements.title: Eid al-Adha Celebration
announcements.body: A.R.M.S. invites all students to join in celebrating Eid al-Adha. The school community comes together to recognise and honour this important occasion for our Muslim students and staff.

announcements.title: CSEC Examinations - Preparation Reminder
announcements.body: CSEC examinations are approaching. All Form 5 students should ensure their registration is complete and review their timetables. Extra tutoring sessions are available after school. See your class teacher for details.

announcements.title: Inter-School Cricket Tournament
announcements.body: A.R.M.S. cricket team will be competing in the Essequibo Schools Sports Association inter-school cricket tournament. Show your school spirit and come support our team!

announcements.title: CXC CSEC School of the Year 2021-2022
announcements.body: Anna Regina Multilateral School continues to celebrate its recognition as CXC CSEC School of the Year for 2021-2022. This achievement reflects the hard work of our students, teachers, and the entire school community. Let us build on this legacy!
